findings.title: Delete action can never appear in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: canDelete is now computed as ruler-ability OR Grafana prom-rule ability, but rendering is still gated by `canDelete && rulerRule`. In the new list view RuleActionsButtons.V2/GrafanaRuleListItem pass only promRule and no rulerRule, so Delete never renders there even for users with delete permission, despite the new prom-rule ability check. The Grafana-prom delete branch is dead code; the guard (or the handleDelete contract, which currently requires a RulerRuleDTO) must be adapted for prom-only rules.

findings.title: Pause action can never appear in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: canPause is now computed as ruler-ability OR Grafana prom-rule ability, but the menu item is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` is true and it renders MenuItemPauseRule with that rulerRule. In the new list view no rulerRule is supplied, so Pause is always hidden for Grafana rules even when the prom-rule ability allows it, making the newly added grafanaPauseAbility check ineffective for this action.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only Grafana rules
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can now show Silence based on the Grafana prom-rule ability and calls handleSilence, which sets showSilenceDrawer=true. The drawer itself is only rendered when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true, but the new list view passes only promRule and leaves `rule` undefined. Clicking 'Silence notifications' in the list view therefore does nothing instead of opening SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer.

findings.title: Grafana rule list items are rendered without a React key
findings.body: The grafana branch returns <GrafanaRuleListItem> without the `key={key}` that GrafanaRuleLoader had and that the datasource branch still has. FilterView appends pages and batches of rules over time, so React will reconcile these items by index; component-local state in RuleActionsButtons/AlertRuleMenu (delete modal, silence drawer, clone redirect) can be reused for a different rule and list updates will be inefficient/incorrect. Restore key={key} on GrafanaRuleListItem.

findings.title: Federated rule groups lose their immutable protection
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously computed isFederated via isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) and treated federated rules as immutable (Update/Delete/Pause unsupported). It now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, where isFederated is hardcoded to false with a TODO. CombinedRule consumers will therefore offer edit/delete/pause for federated (cross-tenant Mimir) rule groups that must not be edited this way, leading to enabled actions that should be unsupported and will fail or act on the wrong tenant scope.
